bullets: The chat header now picks the Freebuff wordmark variant by measuring each logo's width against the panel space instead of using a fixed breakpoint, falling back to plain text when none fit.
Hosts can now inject image-bearing messages into a running turn through the steering drain hook, which accepts structured prompts, image parts, and awaits async attachment bytes.

Freebuff CLI 0.1.3 now pins a baseline build only with evidence from Bun's CPU report, cpuinfo, or sysctl, and a crash record stores that evidence so machines can return to the optimized build on the next update.
BYOK connections now clamp model compaction summaries to each model's real output cap, rejecting truncated summaries and falling back to mechanical compaction instead of dropping session content.

MCP tool registration now preserves zod v4 schemas during deep copy and stores plain JSON Schemas in agent state, and non-image resources degrade to descriptive text instead of base64 decode failures.
Muse Spark 1.3 is now the offered Muse Spark row in the catalog, while 1.2 is dropped from the free list and marked paid-only and superseded.
Spawn agent results from last_message agents now arrive as plain text, with silent children returning an error message instead of an array.
The SDK and agent runtime now expose onCompactionStart and onCompactionEnd callbacks so hosts can bracket a compaction pass with start and end events.
The CLI landing screen and chat header now show a streak status line reporting today's bonus Freebucks and the next reset time in the terminal's local time.
The onboarding questionnaire now offers a Desktop surface alongside Web and mobile, sharing form logic so Web and Desktop cannot post different answers.
The home hero product tab pick is now tracked via a new freebuff.home_hero_surface_chosen event and a Desktop download is recorded at the new home_hero location constant.
The referral chip label for tiktok now covers Instagram and Facebook, consolidating Facebook write-in answers under the existing id with a tally version bump.
GLM 5.3 Flash gains an ending-soon badge showing the deal's Sep 30 deadline and 15/hr after price.
The decision log now keeps L2 ranker shadow-decision counters while dropping campaign identifiers from Axiom telemetry.
Bookmark gate analytics events were retired from the Freebuff enums since the bookmark gate flow no longer exists.
